registration.scope: Bounded implementation assessment of fixed-observed-mean component inference; not a general coverage qualification or a replacement for historical passes or failures.
registration.authority: Owner accepted the complete Mean component inference plan and requested implementation, including a bounded new sampling assessment.

primary.q1_covariance: Predeclared diagnostic: two concentrated modes, with remainder leading share approximately one.
primary.variance: Positive quadratic in normalized leverage midranks, within both native structured model spans; exact Mata retains its own target-specific smoother.
primary.design: Complete worker-by-firm grid with outcome-free varying observation multiplicities or whole-match integer masses. q1 uses concentrated target mass, not outcome-driven q selection.
primary.spectral_interpretation: Report exact finite-sample shares at both dimensions. No universal diffuseness cutoff or claim follows from the fixture name. Outcome-free q0 largest shares are at most 0.214 in this grid; q1 primary leading shares are 0.914--0.959 and remainder shares at most 0.136.
primary.count_note: 2000 is the proposed production precision; measure development runtime before freezing an assessment manifest. Any bounded-scope amendment must precede assessment outcomes, preserve this registration, and be recorded separately.

diagnostic_grid.interpretation: All attempts and targets are descriptive; no post-result relabeling of primary cells. Gaussian oracle moments do not describe the heavy-tail cell. Estimated-offset diagnostics compare to an explicitly known-offset FE oracle, not an exact sampling law for estimated controls.

numerics.solver: Explicit diagonal; unchanged default phase tolerances and original-system residual gates
numerics.rng: Independent NumPy PCG64 outcome stream addressed by SHA256(domain, canonical cell, replication), production Counter-V1 numerical addresses; fixed outcome-free numerical seeds per cell/reference across outcome draws. Separate pipeline/development/assessment/diagnostic domains. Mean and fixed-c0 use the same draws and numerical seed.
numerics.fixed_c0: Population mean of the retained working outcome from known DGP; None inference on y-c0.
numerics.actual_mean: Recompute retained physical-frequency working mean on every outcome draw; treat it as fixed only inside inference calculations.

descriptive_screens.status: Descriptive screens registered before outcomes, not public-enablement coverage qualification. Engineering errors block completion; scientific screen failures are enumerated without retuning.
descriptive_screens.q1_conservatism: No upper coverage penalty. q1 highrank SE is descriptive, not a validity gate for AM endpoints.
descriptive_screens.rationale: Broad screens expose material calibration or approximation problems in a bounded assessment. They neither replace older stricter policies nor establish general coverage. 2000 independent outcomes give about 0.0049 binomial MCSE at 95% coverage.

engineering_gates.sample: Every designed row retained; exact counts and physical-frequency mean semantics.
engineering_gates.inventory: Exact unique cell/replication/arm/target keys, frozen dimensions, seeds, source, binaries and expected row counts; classify every attempt.

registration.source_binding: Freeze all runtime package files, native payload hashes, harness source hashes, registration hash, exact source commit plus dirty-content identities, DGP/geometry, numerical settings and task inventory before each run. Assessment uses immutable copies. Aggregate only complete validated outputs.
registration.execution: Local private licensed Stata by default. No large run before measured pilot. SCC requires the cluster skill, a tiny local complete path, one real 1--4-core end-to-end smoke, and scheduler dependencies. No public licensed runner.
registration.historical_evidence: All prior observation/match inference and centering experiments retain original identities, failures and scope. No historical receipt is modified.

amendments.reason: Independent harness review before assessment found missing native point/metadata validation and insufficient separation of engineering failures from statistical withholding. Development smoke also found CSV float coercion, physical/stored count confusion and absent Mata q0-status handling. Original development attempts remain preserved.
amendments.point_mcse: Request mcse(all), the ordinary production diagnostic, and export its availability, mode and centering convention separately from inference metadata.

native_point_gate.reference: Independent dense exact point on the same realized working outcome
native_point_gate.authority: Existing development_acceptance_v1.json randomized equivalence policy; exact reference has zero numerical MCSE. No post-result relaxation.

amendments.transport: Import numeric CSV as double; validate e(N_stored) separately from e(N_physical); exact Mata highrank has no target-local q0 status matrix and successful calls imply status zero.
amendments.failure_classification: Interpreter/process/unknown/native structural or solver errors block the pipeline. Only explicitly enumerated maintained statistical withholding is counted as a scientific unavailable result. Atomic failures must agree across all four target rows; target codes and endpoint missingness must match their current route/reference schema.
amendments.mean_approximation_screen: Apply the already registered exact Gaussian discrepancy RMS/actual SD screen and expose q1 conditional-remainder discrepancy in reports. No new asymptotic claim is inferred.
amendments.variance_model_precision: The primary variance is in the intended exact-design leverage-rank span. Native regressors use estimated JLA leverage and target ranks, so this does not assert exact specification in every realized numerical basis.
amendments.estimated_offset_diagnostic: Add independent within-match weighted-zero-mean contrasts so first-stage controls genuinely have estimation error. Build each realized dense point reference from independently estimated WLS controls held fixed for the FE-only oracle; known-offset Gaussian covariance remains diagnostic, not the exact unconditional law.

numerical_registration.scope: Fixed-outcome numerical sensitivity only; no sampling coverage claim or numerical-seed selection.
numerical_registration.outcome_identity: Use the primary geometry and variance DGP at dimension12, keyed only by its original route/reference/k12 primary cell name and replication1 in the separate numerical_fixed_outcome domain. Budget and numerical-seed task labels never enter the outcome key. Preserve identical input CSV hashes across all12 numerical settings for each route/reference.
reports: point error relative to exact dense oracle
numerical_registration.interpretation: Three seeds provide a bounded sensitivity check, not reliable tail calibration. Keep all seeds and failures; never select the most favorable interval or adapt budgets after observing results.
